All published versions of Wizard Scoreboard with their changes. Older versions can be downloaded below.

v3.5.2 (2026-10-12)

Download APK v3.5.2

  • Preserve short game session flags on reload

    Add regression test and persist BlindBids/ShortGame in session copying.

v3.5.1 (2026-10-11)

Download APK v3.5.1

  • Add round bid total label

    Add localized bold round bid total label to ScoreBoardPage.

  • Add localized privacy policy pages

    Add privacy policy translations and language-specific pages for multiple locales, update localized PrivacyPolicyUrl mappings and localization tests.

  • Add dealer hint for short-game deals

    Add localized DealCardsHint text.

  • Expand languages and update translations

    Expanded supported languages and flag display on the website, added Simplified Chinese rules pages, localized and refined rule text plus multiple.resx translations, expanded the roadmap.

v3.5.0 (2026-10-11)

Download APK v3.5.0

  • Add de-AT/de-CH localization support

    Added German regional support for Austria and Switzerland, updated localization fallback and supported culture lists, exposed both languages in Settings, adjusted tests for culture resolution/language ordering/resource completeness, updated beta welcome text for Swiss German.

  • Add JA/KO/ZH-Hans localization support

    Complete the localization rollout for Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese by adding full resource files, rule pages, culture mapping, settings picker entries, and expanded completeness/fallback tests.

  • Add FI/NB/SV localization and rules

    Add Finnish, Norwegian, and Swedish localization support across tests, supported cultures, settings language lists, and resource files; add quick/full rules HTML for these languages; update localization fallback coverage and settings language ordering tests.

  • Refine bug report diagnostics and localization

    Move device/app details into BugReportDiagnostics, add English technical labels and app-state context (settings, current game status, navigation trail and font scale), update the localized header, add tests.

  • Add Ukrainian, Indonesian, and Malay locales

    Add localization support for Ukrainian, Indonesian, and Malay, including Malay rule files, updated culture fallback mappings, completeness tests.

  • Add Lithuanian and Greek localization

    Added Lithuanian quick/full rules HTML pages with localized game instructions, variants, scoring, and beta reminder updates. Replaced and expanded Lithuanian and Greek resource strings for UI text, bug reports, rules labels, and variant descriptions.

  • Add localization support for new languages

    Add pl-PL and pt-PT support with culture fallbacks and settings entries, expand localization tests, add Czech/Polish/Portuguese rule pages, update roadmap status, refresh the Czech strings/resx beta guidance.

v3.4.2 (2026-10-11)

Download APK v3.4.2

  • Align round validation with card counts

    Use session card counts for round generation and validation; update tests to the new PlayerInputViewModel constructor.

v3.4.1 (2026-10-11)

Download APK v3.4.1

  • Add round schedule service and tests

    Centralize cards-per-round logic in a new RoundSchedule service, add short-game coverage for 3–6 players with validation tests, mark the blind-bidding roadmap item as complete.

v3.4.0 (2026-10-11)

Download APK v3.4.0

  • Add advanced settings toggle to Settings page

    Introduce a persisted ShowAdvancedSettings preference and split Settings into basic and advanced sections. Move bid-total rule, bold-all-text, export, and import controls behind the new advanced switch, add localized labels, add tests.

  • Support hidden group options in settings

    Add globally hidden group options with settings for bid-rule and dealer-picks-trump visibility, plus a default dealer-picks-trump value when hidden. Update player selection and game-start behavior to respect hidden options and preserve group values. Extend Groups and Settings UI, add localized strings, cover hidden-option and JSON behaviors with unit tests, and mark roadmap item 17 complete.

  • Refactor switch rows and settings sections

    Use UiFactory.CreateSwitchRow and CreateSectionHeader across pages, expand beta welcome opt-out caption support, add settings localization strings.

  • Add localized beta settings strings

    Add localized beta settings strings.

v3.3.2 (2026-10-10)

Download APK v3.3.2

  • Use source-gen JSON and typed MAUI bindings

    Switched MAUI pages to strongly typed bindings, replaced reflection-based JsonSerializer usage with AppJsonContext source-generated metadata, added indented backup serialization support, covered JSON round-tripping and backup formatting with unit tests, enabled trimming-friendly Android Release publishing, disabled reflection-based JSON by default.

  • Add haptics and accessibility improvements

    Add user-controlled haptic feedback with persistence, vibration triggers, and Android permission handling. Improve icon button accessibility metadata, tighten color contrast, add WCAG contrast tests, update translations.

v3.3.1 (2026-10-09)

Download APK v3.3.1

  • Add game variants and hidden bids support

    Persist per-group variants and copy them into sessions, enforce special-card and Cloud bid rules, mask hidden bids in the scoreboard, and add localized strings plus tests. Add Special cards: Bomb/Dragon/Fairy and Cloud/Juggler

  • Add player stats to highscore screen

    Add per-player statistics to the Highscore view, persist finished games for stats calculation, update DI and tests, add localized empty-state and dialog text.

v3.2.2 (2026-10-09)

Download APK v3.2.2

  • Expand test game generation scenarios

    Add scenario-driven test game generation, update saved-game round display, and cover new validation and generator tests. Update chart for multiple winners

  • Add charts

    Added score chart views from scoreboard and saved games, improved scoring and podium logic, dealer-bid validation, player chart colors, localized strings, expanded tests.

  • Add game summary flow and scoring

    Introduce a post-match game summary page with podium-style results, ranking, achievements, and image sharing. Add a calculator for final standings and bid-based records, improve trump selector layout and input touch handling, extend unit tests, update localized strings.

  • feat: tablet and landscape layout (roadmap item 10)

v3.2.0 (2026-10-09)

Download APK v3.2.0

  • Refactor pages into MVVM view models

    Move major page logic into dedicated MVVM view models, including score grid calculations, dialog validation, and bindable list item models. Update pages to bind to the new models, add tests for the view models and score grid logic, and apply the project/package fixes needed for build and dependency resolution.
